title: Near Downtown 3BR | Workspace + 2-Car Garage
description:
Built for work trips and longer stays: a dedicated workspace with ethernet, in-unit washer/dryer and 3 en-suite bedrooms, so nobody shares a bath. This 3BR/3.5BA townhome near downtown Nashville sleeps 10, with a 2-car garage, a rooftop deck with downtown skyline views and keyless self check-in. No pets, parties or smoking.

The space
Explore Music City, then return to a townhome where your group can spend time together and retreat to separate bedrooms for rest. Spread across three levels, the house offers three full en suite bathrooms and an additional half bathroom upstairs—making getting ready for Nashville outings easier.
Sleeping arrangements and floor plan

Bottom level

Bedroom 1: King bed with a full en suite bathroom.
Garage

Second level

Bedroom 2: King bed with a full en suite bathroom.
Bedroom 3: Two queen beds with a full en suite bathroom.

Third level

The top level features the kitchen, a half bathroom, and a washer and dryer. Step directly from the kitchen onto the walk-out deck for a breath of fresh air between Nashville adventures.

Additional sleeping arrangements

Sleeper sofa
Queen air mattress

Amenities at a glance

• Entire townhome for your group’s exclusive use
• Three bedrooms and 3½ bathrooms
• Two king beds and two queen beds
• Full en suite bathroom in every bedroom
• Sleeper sofa and queen air mattress
• Private walk-out deck
• Kitchen
• Washer and dryer
• Garage
• Contactless, keyless self check-in
• 24/7 guest support from Playlist Properties

Located on Fern Avenue in Nashville, Tennessee, this townhome offers a home base for a trip filled with live music, dining, sports, and sightseeing.

Build your Nashville itinerary around:

• Broadway: Explore downtown’s honky-tonks and live-music venues.
• Ryman Auditorium: Plan a concert outing or visit this historic music venue.
• Nissan Stadium: Include a game or scheduled event in your trip.
• Bridgestone Arena: Head downtown for sports or live entertainment.
• Music City Center: Plan transportation for conventions and business events.
• East Nashville and Five Points: Explore restaurants, coffee shops, and neighborhood businesses.

For flights, check your route to and from Nashville International Airport (BNA). Allow extra travel time during peak traffic, concerts, conventions, and sporting events.

Guest access
You’ll have private access to the entire property, including the townhome, deck, and garage.

Check-in is contactless and keyless. You’ll receive an entry code and arrival instructions before your stay, allowing you to let yourself in at check-in time.

Other things to note
Live Music Experience – By Request!
Want to make your Nashville trip even more unforgettable? 

We can arrange for a private acoustic set performed by a local Nashville recording artist right in the comfort of our home! The Artist will play a mix of your favorite covers and original songs. Just ask us how to book it!

We provide a starter supply of basic guest amenities to help you settle in comfortably. These are not restocked during your stay and include:

* 2 rolls of toilet paper per bathroom
* 2 rolls of paper towels
* 1 cleaning sponge
* A handful of K-Cups or a small bag of ground coffee

For longer stays or larger groups, we recommend bringing or purchasing any additional supplies you may need.

This property has specific local compliance requirements. Before check-in, guests must complete a signed rental agreement, identity verification, and a $1,000 - $1,500 security hold. The security hold is not a traditional security deposit, it is only a temporary pending authorization on your payment method.

As an optional alternative to the security hold, guests may purchase a non-refundable damage waiver through a third-party provider. The damage waiver is completely optional.

We make everything easy and secure by using Happy Guest, a convenient online platform that requires no app download or account setup. Through the secure guest portal, you can quickly complete your verification, view important property details, access check-in instructions, explore local Nashville recommendations, and take advantage of optional upgrades to enhance your stay.

Local guests within 25 miles must inquire before booking.
Smoke-free property violations incur a $150 fee.
Quiet hours after 10 PM for a restful experience.
